newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Saudi man for killing relative.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Saudi man for killing relative.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded a Saudi man for shooting dead a male relative who had made fun of him, Saudi state-run television said.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the television said the victim was killed by one bullet in his chest. It did not say how the men were related, but said both were from the Eneizi tribe.
The beheading in the Saudi capital Riyadh was the third execution in the conservative kingdom this year.
The kingdom enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals.
